name: crumbs cell polarity complex component 1

function.text: CRB1 is the approved symbol for crumbs cell polarity complex component 1. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in calcium ion binding; cell-cell signaling; establishment or maintenance of cell polarity.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include inherited retinal dystrophy (autosomal recessive); Leber congenital amaurosis 8 (autosomal recessive). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Esophageal carcinoma; Pancreatic adenocarcinoma; Gastric adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: CRB1 encodes crumbs cell polarity complex component 1. Its functions include calcium ion binding and cell-cell signaling.

germline.text: Germline disease associations include inherited retinal dystrophy (autosomal recessive); Leber congenital amaurosis 8 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CRB1 have been reported in esophageal carcinoma, gastric adenocarcinoma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.
